description: Search the ClinicalTrials.gov v2 study registry. Provide any combination of query terms (condition, intervention, title, location, sponsor, general term) — multiple query.* terms are ANDed together — plus optional filters (status, geo, advanced Essie expression, explicit NCT ids). Returns { totalCount?, studies: [...], nextPageToken? }. Use `fields` to trim the response to specific fields/modules, `sort` to order (e.g. '@relevance', 'LastUpdatePostDate:desc', 'EnrollmentCount:desc'), and pageSize/pageToken to page. GET /studies.

advanced.description: Advanced Essie expression applied as an additional filter (maps to filter.advanced).

condition.description: Disease / condition to match (maps to query.cond), e.g. 'diabetes'.

countTotal.description: Include the total number of matching studies (totalCount) on the first page.

fields.description: Fields or modules to return, e.g. ['NCTId','BriefTitle','OverallStatus'] or ['protocolSection.identificationModule']. Omit to return full study records.

geoFilter.description: Geo filter as a raw geo-function string (maps to filter.geo), e.g. 'distance(39.0027,-77.1,50mi)'.

ids.description: Restrict to these NCT ids (maps to filter.ids), e.g. ['NCT00841061'].

intervention.description: Treatment / drug / intervention to match (maps to query.intr).

location.description: Study location text, e.g. a city/state/country (maps to query.locn).

pageSize.description: Number of studies per page (1–1000; API default 10).

pageToken.description: Opaque token from a previous response's nextPageToken, to fetch the next page.

status.description: Filter by overall recruitment status (maps to filter.overallStatus). One or more of: ACTIVE_NOT_RECRUITING, COMPLETED, ENROLLING_BY_INVITATION, NOT_YET_RECRUITING, RECRUITING, SUSPENDED, TERMINATED, WITHDRAWN, AVAILABLE, NO_LONGER_AVAILABLE, TEMPORARILY_NOT_AVAILABLE, APPROVED_FOR_MARKETING, WITHHELD, UNKNOWN.

term.description: General full-text 'other terms' query (maps to query.term).

title.description: Words in the study title (maps to query.titles).

name: search_studies
title: Search clinical trials (ClinicalTrials.gov)
